headlines.description: — Tyler Herro scored 30 points, Bam Adebayo finished with 23 points and 16 rebounds, and the Miami Heat used a 14-0 run in the final moments to rally past the Philadelphia 76ers 119-109 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat rally late, use 14-0 run in final moments to pull away and beat 76ers 119-109

headlines.description: — Onyeka Okongwu and Jalen Johnson each scored 20 points, and three days after losing to the Celtics on the road, the Hawks responded with a 112-102 win over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Hawks surge past the Celtics 112-102, riding a big third quarter and a 13th straight home win

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 36 points on 16-of-24 shooting, Jalen Green added 21 points, and the Phoenix Suns beat the Memphis Grizzlies 131-105 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devin Booker scores 36 on 16-of-24 shooting, Suns beat Grizzlies 131-105

events.name: Chicago Bulls at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: Victor Wembanyama had a season-high 41 points and 16 rebounds while collecting the third-fastest double-double since 1997-98 in the Spurs' win Monday.

— Dallas native Julius Randle scored 24 points, Anthony Edwards had 17 points off the bench in his return following a six-game absence, and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Dallas Mavericks 124-94 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Randle scores 24, Edwards adds 17 in return from injury, as Wolves rout Mavericks 124-94

headlines.description: — Evan Mobley and Donovan Mitchell each scored 34 points and the Cleveland Cavaliers used a late fourth-quarter surge to beat the Utah Jazz 122-113 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mobley and Mitchell each score 34 but Cavs need late run to dunk Jazz

events.name: Detroit Pistons at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 47 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Detroit Pistons 114-110 in overtime on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander erupts for 47 points as Thunder outlast Pistons 114-110 in OT

events.name: Washington Wizards at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — LeBron James had 21 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds, Austin Reaves added 19 points and nine assists, and the Los Angeles Lakers rolled to a 120-101 win over the Washington Wizards on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Luka Doncic suspended, LeBron James' triple-double powers Lakers to 120-101 win over Wizards
